Before you start

Have these ready:

  • Proof that you are enrolled, or have been accepted, at type of institution.
  • Your most recent grades or transcript.
  • Any other document, for example proof of household income.

Each program page lists anything extra.

Step by step

  1. Pick a program. Read the program page and check the deadline. Deadlines are exact and name their time zone.
  2. Check that you qualify. The "Who can apply" list on each program page is the whole test. If you are unsure, contact us before you apply.
  3. Create an account. You use it to save your application and come back to it. How accounts work, to be confirmed.
  4. Fill in the form and upload your documents. Say whether applicants can save and finish later.
  5. Wait for our decision. We tell every applicant the result by email by date or number of weeks.

After you apply

Say what confirmation applicants receive, whether they can change an application before the deadline, and when it is locked for reviewers.

If you need help

Write to us through the contact form. Please do not send documents by email.

Questions and answers

Who can apply?

Each program has its own list on its page, under "Who can apply". General rule, for example residency or enrolment.

Can I apply to more than one program?

Yes or no, and any limit.

What documents do I need?

See "Before you start" above. Each program page lists anything extra.

When will I hear back?

Number of weeks after the deadline. We email every applicant, whether or not they receive an award.

What if I miss the deadline?

The form closes at the exact time shown on the program page, in the time zone shown there. Say whether late applications are ever considered.

How are decisions made?

Describe who reads applications, what they look for, and how ties are settled. Say that every applicant is judged by the same criteria.

How is my personal information used?

See our privacy notice.
